description: A stocky man in a black clerical coat and round black hat stands on a dim heath at dusk, carrying a brown paper parcel under one arm and a furled dark umbrella in the other hand. Behind him, far off to the left, a tall dark silhouette in a long coat and hat stands among low scrub under a smoky orange-and-grey sky. The painting is a dark, painterly oil style, filling the whole frame with no border.
